title: NodeConfig omits authenticated RPL admission field contract
description: Documentation review of myil implementation found NodeConfig's Attributes section does not describe rpl_instance_id, rpl_dodag_id, rpl_dodag_version, rpl_mop, or rpl_dio_expected_role, including their all-or-none admission-scope requirement and current non-storing MOP constraint. Document the public configuration contract so callers do not accidentally leave DIO bootstrap disabled or mis-scope trusted DIOs.
notes: Documented every public RPL admission configuration field, all-or-none activation, expected signer role, and current non-storing MOP 1 constraint.
